title: 1812: two houses and the garrison's cornfield at the forks
items: Walk up the main stem to the forks in 1812 and two small log houses stand there, one either side of the river, where Captain Whistler's 1808 draught draws them: a discharged soldier's, and the house we take for Clark the cattle dealer's.
Beside Clark's, on the south bank, a long rail-fenced field of eight acres: the 'Company Garden & public Cornfield' the draught letters there. The corn itself isn't drawn yet.
